## Projects

- **FIR-AI — Investigation Assistant for Kerala Police** — AI-powered investigation assistant with a 100% custom-built AI engine: real-time FIR analysis, entity extraction, case intelligence, legal guidance, and multilingual support. https://github.com/Ahamedshakir02/firai — case study: https://shakir-s-portfolio.vercel.app/work/fir-ai
- **ThengaPari — Agri-Harvest Marketplace** — hyperlocal marketplace for Kerala built as a Melos monorepo: four standalone Flutter apps (Homeowner, Worker, Site Manager, B2B) sharing one core package and one Firebase backend, with TypeScript Cloud Functions, Razorpay payments, and Riverpod state. https://github.com/Ahamedshakir02/Thengapari — case study: https://shakir-s-portfolio.vercel.app/work/thengapari
- **Real-Time GPS & IMU Safety Monitoring App (TailSafe)** — ESP32 firmware reading a Neo-6M GPS and MPU6050 IMU, streaming over BLE and WebSocket into a React Native app, with automatic accident SOS detection, geofencing, live maps, and offline microSD logging. https://github.com/Ahamedshakir02/TailSafe — case study: https://shakir-s-portfolio.vercel.app/work/tailsafe
- **Stroke Prediction on Imbalanced Clinical Data** — SVM, Decision Tree and KNN compared on a stroke dataset with 972 negative to 50 positive test cases, using SMOTE resampling and StandardScaler. Best accuracy 89.2% (Decision Tree), mean 82.9%; the Decision Tree recovers 8 of 50 stroke cases (recall 0.16) while the less accurate SVM recovers 24 of 50 (recall 0.48), which is the finding the project is built around. https://github.com/Ahamedshakir02/Strokeprediction-ML — case study: https://shakir-s-portfolio.vercel.app/work/stroke-prediction
- **Holytouch — Construction & Design Studio Site** — premium multi-page client website for a Kerala construction & design firm (React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Lenis), with a branded preloader and page-transition curtain. Live: https://holytouch-website.vercel.app — source: https://github.com/Ahamedshakir02/holytouch-website — case study: https://shakir-s-portfolio.vercel.app/work/holytouch
- **Safari Typing Services — Bilingual Business Site** — bilingual English/Arabic client website for a government document-services centre in Ajman, UAE: 15 service detail pages, WhatsApp-first contact flow, JSON-LD. Live: https://www.safaritypingservices.com — source: https://github.com/Ahamedshakir02/safari-typing — case study: https://shakir-s-portfolio.vercel.app/work/safari-typing

## Experience

- **Freelance Engineer — Web & AI** (Jun 2026 – present, Kerala, India, working remotely). Shipping production work for clients since graduating: Safari Typing Services, a bilingual English/Arabic document-services centre in Ajman, UAE, live at safaritypingservices.com; and Holytouch, a construction and design firm in Kerala. Also built ThengaPari, a Melos monorepo of four standalone Flutter apps on one Firebase backend. Handles briefs end to end — scoping, design system, build, SEO and structured data, deployment, and post-launch changes.

- **Campus Lead — GTech µLearn, MES College of Engineering** (Jul 2025 – Apr 2026). GTech µLearn is Kerala's largest student developer community, backed by the Government of Kerala. Grew active student participation by 40%, ran 10+ technical workshops (AI, Web Dev, Cybersecurity, Open Source) reaching 100+ students per semester, and coordinated 10+ mentors across institutions.
